title: Live notification permission acceptance
acceptance: Opt-in OS notifications delivered and checkpointed across restart on the real Mac
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens, private channel IDs or personal data in Git.
validation: Owner-observed result recorded in the parent record
escalation: Owner action: this step needs the owner's access, choice or observation

effort.basis: Initial plan from the record's Check at featurePlans adoption; estimate, owner may revise. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 0.25 hours agent + 0.25 hours owner; agent records; the owner grants and observes notifications. Method: a judged rate of about 1.5 agent hours per former focused day, not a calculation, informed by NERV merge history (50 feature and fix PRs #140–#276, previous merge to merge, a throughput proxy: median about 0.56 h, p75 2.1–2.7 h by quantile method, p90 about 5.1 h) and B-046-T02 (2-day estimate, about 0.75 h stated to implement); a step that is a PR of its own takes at least 0.75 h with review and CI, while an agent part that only prepares or records for an owner step may be less. Machine time of real-model or device runs is not counted. Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 0.5 kept as history. Re-estimated 2026-11-12 at 0.6x from `work-items calibrate` (median 0.55x over 6 closed steps; bug steps 0.6x over 5): 0.25 h → 0.25 h, min 0.5 h; owner hours and baseline kept.
